name: Phind
tagline: Phind is an AI-powered search engine purpose-built for developers and technical questions. It retrieves relevant code, documentation, and Stack Overflow answers, then synthesises a direct response with working code examples. Engineers use Phind when they want a technical answer faster than they'd get from scrolling through search results or waiting for a ChatGPT response.
